mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `join_application` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `created_at` >= CURDATE() AND `created_at` < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `join_application` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `status` = 'PENDING' )
SELECT * FROM `join_application` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `company_id` = #{companyId} AND `status` = 'PENDING' ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: ja.`id`, ja.`user_id` AS userId, ja.`company_id` AS companyId, ja.`apply_role` AS applyRole, ja.`status`, ja.`reviewer_id` AS reviewerId, ja.`reviewed_at` AS reviewedAt, ja.`reject_reason` AS rejectReason, ja.`created_at` AS createdAt, c.`name` AS companyName, u.`nickname` AS userNickname, u.`phone` AS userPhone, r.`nickname` AS reviewerNickname
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `join_application` ja JOIN `user` u ON u.`id` = ja.`user_id` JOIN `company` c ON c.`id` = ja.`company_id` LEFT JOIN `user` r ON r.`id` = ja.`reviewer_id` WHERE ja.`company_id` = #{companyId} AND ja.`status` = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ja.`created_at`
